Something Aleksander Barkov said last month stuck with me. The toughest part of his injury was "not to live life as a hockey player for the Florida Panthers."

I dug deeper into that identity crisis. Really thoughtful stuff from Landeskog, Seguin & Eichel:

Panthers outscored 9-1 the last 24 hours.  Tonight, to a decimated Penguins lineup.

Panthers goalie Cooper Black, on paper at least, grew an inch in the past day.

He was listed at 6-foot-8 yesterday. Listed at 6-9 today.

Regardless, he'll become the tallest goalie to play in the NHL when he starts in Pittsburgh tonight.

Cooper Black is expected to start tonight for the Panthers in Pittsburgh. At 6’8” he will be the tallest goalie in NHL history.

There have been 4 goalies listed at 6’7”: Ben Bishop, Mikko Koskinen, Ivan Fedotov & Mads Sogaard

17 goalies listed at 6’6” in NHL history.
